# StudioBridge
> Agent bridge for FL Studio. Read, edit, and render FL Studio projects from any coding agent — verified, reversible, local.

## Overview
- Project: StudioBridge
- CLI: sbridge
- Protocol: MIDI / SysEx 2-way RPC (Magic bytes 53 42)
- Target Host: FL Studio 21-26 on Windows x64 and ARM64
- License: MIT (Copyright (C) 2026 WantedChip)
- Telemetry: Zero telemetry, 100% local

## Interfaces
- Model Context Protocol (MCP): Standard tool suites for inspect, live control, offline FLP authoring, and headless rendering.
- Command Line Interface: `sbridge` console script.
- Python SDK: Pure-Python client libraries with universal wheels.
